data.name: Mintu
data.gender_notes: Mintu is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Manditu', meaning 'gratifying' or 'delightful'. In Hindu mythology, Mintu is a name associated with the god Ganesha, who is known for his intelligence and wisdom. This name signifies a strong-willed, intelligent, and delightful individual. The name Mintu carries the meaning “Intelligent, Delightful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mintu usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, delightful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Mintu belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intelligent, Delightful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mintu total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
